answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on knowledge-oriented sequenceto-sequence (Seq2Seq) pre-training objectives for PLMs, so that they can be applied to Natural Language Generation (NLG) tasks, such as the data‑to‑text task. ... After pre‑training PRINCE, we evaluate it on two data‑to‑text datasets that require entity knowledge: WebNLG and WikiBio.
answer_1.outputs: generated textual descriptions (e.g., sentences describing RDF triples or biography entries)

answer_2.quote: pre‑trained PRINCE ... improves the results over the original BART model (+ 2.25%/0.70%/1.58% for BLEU/METEOR/ROUGE‑L scores, paired t‑test, p‑value<0.01).

answer_4.quote: We perform manual evaluations with 100 examples from the test set of WebNLG. Three annotators are involved in deciding whether the generated entities are faithful and readable.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge each generated sentence on faithfulness (accuracy of meaning) and readability (ease of understanding).
